title: Changelog - August 2019
text:
## Changelog - August 2019
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000093690
New Features:
We improved the way that the system determines the completeness of the various member information tabs in the member dashboard. Now a tab will be considered complete if all of the required fields in the form used for the tab have been filled with information. If the form does not have any required fields, it makes sure that at least one of the fields in the form has been filled with information.
We added the ability to display multiple Form Manager forms in the same widget or page body on the frontend of sites.
We released the Profile Cover Photo Add-On. Click here for more information.
We added a setting to include the "Website Signature" in all automatic emails sent by the System. In order to use this new feature, navigate to the Admin >> Settings >> General Settings >> Settings >> Default Email Signature section.
We released the Homepage Background Slider Add-On. Click here for more information.
We added the ability to include the name of the forms that are used on a frontend page when using the "Show Widgets" overlay option when viewing the page as the Admin of the site. To see this overlay, click on the "Show Widget" button after clicking on "Visit Site" from the Admin area.
We added the ability to add notes when manually starting a billing subscription for a member in the Admin.
We created a new homepage and sidebar search module for the Sell Digital Downloads Add-On.
Enhancements / Fixes:
We fixed an issue which was preventing the Events Calendar feature from working properly properly on Sites running PHP 7.
We fixed an issue which was preventing the Events Calendar feature from working properly properly on Sites running PHP 7.
We implemented an update to the Preferred Reply Day and Preferred Reply Time fields in the "Website - Lead Form - Get Matched" form in order to make them fully editable from the Form Manager.
We implemented an update to the Preferred Reply Day and Preferred Reply Time fields in the "Website - Lead Form - Get Matched" form in order to make them fully editable from the Form Manager.
We fixed an issue with the canonical link added to the <head> section of /checkout pages to make it more accurate.
We fixed an issue with the canonical link added to the <head> section of /checkout pages to make it more accurate.
We fixed an issue which was causing the breadcrumb on member profile pages to show the "Profession Name" of the website when the member had not yet selected a Top Level Category.
We fixed an issue which was causing the breadcrumb on member profile pages to show the "Profession Name" of the website when the member had not yet selected a Top Level Category.
We fixed an issue with the "Write a Review" and "Send a Message" pages linked from member profile pages which was causing the breadcrumbs to show the member's country name twice when the member had not selected a city in some cases.
We fixed an issue with the "Write a Review" and "Send a Message" pages linked from member profile pages which was causing the breadcrumbs to show the member's country name twice when the member had not selected a city in some cases.
We implemented a security update to the leads section of the member dashboard to re-confirm a lead had been matched to a member before showing the details of the lead.
We implemented a security update to the leads section of the member dashboard to re-confirm a lead had been matched to a member before showing the details of the lead.
We moved the "Members-Only" setting, price slider fields, and "Post Limit notification" fields to a new section called "Additional Settings" on the "Edit Post Type" page in the Admin.
We moved the "Members-Only" setting, price slider fields, and "Post Limit notification" fields to a new section called "Additional Settings" on the "Edit Post Type" page in the Admin.
We fixed an issue which was causing the member dashboard to show a blank page when a site has set the same form to be used in multiple tabs for the member's Product.
We fixed an issue which was causing the member dashboard to show a blank page when a site has set the same form to be used in multiple tabs for the member's Product.
We made an update to the sidebar used in the member dashboard to display a counter next to the "Sub Accounts" item.  This will display the number of Sub-Accounts the member has under their account.
We updated the "delete options" functionality on the Product page in the Admin in order to unify the logic used here with the logic used to bulk delete / update members on the Search Members page in the Admin.
We fixed an issue which was causing the Stripe payment gateway to not use the website's currency set in the General Settings when Stripe payment gateway credentials were saved.
We fixed an issue which was causing the system to get stuck when saving changes to a menu on the Menu Manager page in the Admin in some cases.
We fixed an issue which was causing the "website logo" to be displayed instead of the "email template logo" when previewing an email template in the Admin.
We fixed an issue which was causing the system to display the "manage leads" link in the Member Dashboard on mobile devices when the "Hide Send Message Links on Listing" Product setting was set to "yes".
We updated the autosuggest UI to not display an area for an image when it is set to not display an image in the Autosuggest Settings in the Admin.
We fixed an issue which was affecting the display of the "Upload CV" buttons in the Member Dashboard when a file has been uploaded and the "Form Layout View" was set "Bootstrap Vertical" for the form in the Form Manager in the Admin.
We fixed an issue which was preventing the "CC Lead Emails to" field on the "Quick Edit" menu for members on the Search Members page in the Admin from working properly.
We updated the "learn more" link under the Private Member Chat Message setting in the General Settings >> Integrations tab in the Admin.
We fixed an issue which was causing the text labels used on the "Member Profile Analytics" page in the Member Dashboard to create additional columns instead of updating the text of the existing columns as expected.
We fixed an issue which was preventing the "Members Only Message" from displaying when a Single Web Page was set to be "Members-Only" in some cases.
We fixed an issue which was causing the system to send the "Direct Match" email template rather than "Indirect Match" email template when bulk matching a lead to members in the Leads >> Manage Leads area of the Admin.
We implemented a security update to prevent "Demo" Admin accounts from saving code to fields in the General Settings and Design Settings area of the Admin.
We fixed a display issue which was causing Multi-Line Text Input field in the "About" member form to not display at the correct size when it does not have the Froala WYSIWYG Editor class assigned to it.
We deprecated the ReCaptcha Checkbox field type on the Toolbox >> Form Manager page in the Admin.
We improved the member sub-sub category search filter in the Admin in order to also search a sub-sub category's associated top level and parent sub category as well.
The dates displayed in the "Date Updated" column of the "301 Redirect" page in the Admin will now respect the date format selected on the General Settings page of the Admin.
We fixed an issue that was preventing the Billing Address information submitted on /checkout pages from being saved in some cases.
We fixed an issue which was affecting the ability to accept payments using the Pay-Per Post Add-On when the site is using 2Checkout as Payment Gateway.
We fixed an issue which was causing the Recent Job widget to display an SQL query in some cases.
We updated the color picker fields in the Admin in order to still apply the selected color when the user clicks out of the color picker field.
We fixed an issue which was causing member categories to link to 404 error pages in some cases.
We updated the Expanded Keyword Search, SSL Secure Website and Google Search Assist Add-Ons to make them fully compatible with the current version of our Add-On Manager system.
We fixed an issue which was preventing breadcrumbs from displaying on member search results pages in some cases.
We fixed an issue which was preventing PDF files from being uploaded by members through the Member Dashboard on servers running PHP 7.
We added the "Request Review" feature to the "Manage Reviews" section of the Member Dashboard when there are no reviews to moderate.
We fixed an issue which was preventing Admins from deleting invoices in the Admin in some cases.
We fixed an issue which was causing the "Edit Listing" button to be covered by the Profile Cover Photo on their profile pages.
We fixed an issue that was preventing the "Edit Listing" button on member profile pages from working properly on mobile devices.
We fixed an issue which was preventing the "Copy to Clipboard" link from working properly on the Sitemap Generator page in the Admin.
In all, over 55 feature enhancements and software updates were released this month.
